title: Designer / Creative
description:
Sobre a Endorfina Wellness Group

A Endorfina Wellness Group é uma holding brasileira focada na construção de um ecossistema integrado de wellness, performance e comunidade.

Hoje o grupo reúne diferentes frentes sob a marca CREW, incluindo:

  • Plataforma digital de treinos e bem-estar (modelo de assinatura)
  • E-commerce de produtos e lifestyle
  • Eventos e experiências presenciais
  • Parcerias estratégicas e novas verticais em desenvolvimento

Com faturamento consolidado próximo a R$ 20 milhões anuais, estamos vivendo um novo ciclo de maturidade organizacional.

A plataforma digital é o núcleo do ecossistema e nosso principal diferencial competitivo. Ela não é apenas um canal — é o centro da experiência, retenção e expansão do grupo.

Contexto da posição

O Designer / Creative Lead terá papel central na construção da percepção estética e visual da marca CREW.

Essa posição não atende apenas marketing. Ela atende todas as áreas da empresa e todas as frentes de negócio.

Isso inclui:

  • Marketing e redes sociais
  • Campanhas de performance
  • CRM e comunicação com clientes
  • Produto digital
  • E-commerce
  • Eventos e experiências presenciais
  • Materiais institucionais

Trata-se de uma função transversal, que influencia diretamente a consistência, clareza e força da marca em todos os pontos de contato com o público.

Missão da posição

Garantir consistência visual, qualidade estética e clareza de comunicação em todos os pontos de contato da marca.

Buscamos um designer sênior que combine:

  • Visão estratégica de marca
  • Pensamento estético apurado
  • Capacidade real de execução

Essa pessoa precisa ser capaz de pensar o design da marca e, ao mesmo tempo, produzir peças com velocidade, consistência e qualidade.

Não é apenas sobre criar peças bonitas. É sobre garantir que a marca seja reconhecida, coerente e forte em todos os canais.

Escopo e responsabilidades

O Designer / Creative Lead será responsável por estruturar e executar a produção visual da marca.

Entre as responsabilidades da posição estão:

Conteúdo e Social Media

  • Criação de peças visuais para redes sociais
  • Desenvolvimento de identidade visual para séries de conteúdo
  • Apoio visual para produção de vídeos e narrativas digitais

Campanhas de Marketing

  • Criação de criativos para campanhas de mídia paga
  • Desenvolvimento de conceitos visuais para campanhas
  • Otimização de criativos com foco em performance

CRM e Comunicação com Clientes

  • Criação de peças para e-mails e comunicações de lifecycle
  • Apoio visual para campanhas de retenção e relacionamento

Produto Digital

  • Apoio visual para experiências dentro da plataforma
  • Criação de assets visuais para o produto

E-commerce

  • Desenvolvimento de materiais visuais para páginas de produto
  • Apoio na construção estética da experiência de compra

Eventos e Experiências Presenciais

  • Materiais visuais para eventos e experiências da comunidade
  • Criação de peças de comunicação e ambientação

Materiais Institucionais

  • Apresentações estratégicas
  • Materiais de comunicação institucional
  • Apoio visual para projetos estratégicos da empresa

Além disso, o designer será responsável por organizar templates, guias e padrões visuais, garantindo consistência de marca e eficiência na produção.

Cultura AI-First

A Endorfina opera com mentalidade AI-First.

Esperamos que o designer utilize inteligência artificial como parte natural do processo criativo.

Entre as aplicações possíveis estão:

  • Exploração de conceitos visuais
  • Geração de variações de layout
  • Organização de referências visuais
  • Aceleração de processos criativos
  • Aumento de produtividade

Mais importante do que dominar ferramentas específicas é ter mentalidade experimental e curiosidade tecnológica

Requirements

Perfil técnico esperado

  • Experiência sólida em design digital
  • Experiência com branding e campanhas
  • Experiência com design para social media e marketing digital
  • Domínio de ferramentas de design
  • Interesse em inteligência artificial aplicada ao design

Perfil comportamental

  • Pensamento estratégico aliado à execução
  • Organização e disciplina
  • Colaboração com múltiplas áreas
  • Alto padrão de exigência estética
  • Capacidade de lidar com múltiplos projetos simultaneamente

Buscamos alguém que entenda que design não é apenas estética — é clareza, consistência e percepção de marca.

Nossa Cultura

Na Endorfina valorizamos:

  • Disciplina
  • Constância
  • Evolução contínua (1% melhor todos os dias)
  • Vida saudável
  • Mentalidade de dono
  • Ambição com responsabilidade
  • Compromisso com resultado

Buscamos alguém que se identifique com esse estilo de vida e mentalidade

Se você quer transformar uma plataforma digital em ativo central de um ecossistema em expansão, essa cadeira foi desenhada para você!

Ao se cadastrar, seu perfil ficará em nosso radar para futuras oportunidades em nossas unidades. Se você tem brilho nos olhos, gosta de desafios e quer atuar em uma rede que cresce e transforma vidas, venha construir essa jornada com a gente!

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Conhecimento dos componentes curriculares no Ensino Fundamental - Anos Finais, Ensino Médio e Militares;
  • Alinhamento com os pilares pedagógicos do Elite: Excelência acadêmica, Cultura de estudo e Sonho grande.

Desejáveis:

  • Experiência como professor no Ensino Fundamental - Anos Finais, Ensino Médio e Militares;
  • Vivência com metodologias ativas e práticas que estimulem a aprendizagem;
  • Participação em projetos pedagógicos, formações e eventos escolares.

Esta vaga contempla a unidade localizada na cidade do Rio de Janeiro.

Aqui no Elite, valorizamos e incentivamos a diversidade. Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, idade, origem, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica. Acreditamos que times diversos constroem uma educação ainda mais transformadora.

title: Team
description:
Overview

Você quer trabalhar duro, se divertir e fazer história? Se sim, a Amazon pode ser a escolha de carreira certa para você. Nossas equipes de logística estão mudando a maneira como interagimos com clientes em todo o mundo todos os dias e resolvendo alguns dos maiores desafios logísticos enfrentados não apenas pela Amazon, mas também por toda a indústria.

As equipes de transporte da Amazon trabalham para garantir a entrega de pacotes para clientes em todo o mundo. Sejam itens grandes ou pequenos, encontramos soluções para garantir que estamos cumprindo nossa promessa para os clientes.

A equipe da Amazon Logística está em busca de um(a) Líder de Time para se juntar à equipe da AMZL Brasil em para a nossa Delivery Station no Rio de Janeiro, RJ.

Key Job Responsibilities

Como líder de equipe, você supervisionará uma de nossas estações de entrega, fornecendo liderança aos associados e gerenciando o desempenho dos principais indicadores - Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Você assumirá muitas funções e trabalhará em um ambiente altamente colaborativo que é mais próximo de uma start-up do que uma grande empresa. A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas. Você precisará prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico.

  • Estar presencialmente na estação de entrega. Amazon lidera operações 24-7, e portanto, trabalhar em diferentes turnos será parte dessa função, incluindo finais de semana e feriados.
  • Criar e cultivar um ambiente de trabalho seguro, identificando oportunidades de segurança em sua área de trabalho.
  • Liderar e treinar os associados para entregar o melhor serviço aos nossos clientes.
  • Garantir que os pedidos dos clientes sejam atendidos de acordo com as diretrizes de segurança e qualidade.
  • Fornecimento contínuo de informações críticas relacionadas ao turno aos operadores.
  • Envolver-se com funções de suporte e/ou outros departamentos para abordar problemas ou necessidades comuns de indicadores de desempenho, por exemplo, processos de readiness, 5S, segurança, treinamento.
  • Monitoramento do andamento das rotas, atuando de forma proativa para identificar e corrigir desvios e adequar, com foco na superação da expectativa do cliente e no gerenciamento dos custos de operação.
  • Condução de reuniões, atribuição de funções e - Trabalhar com KPIs como despacho pontual, sucesso na entrega no primeiro dia (On Time Dispatch, First Day Delivery Success) e aprimoramento do atendimento ao cliente.
  • Ficar obcecado por métricas e mergulhar fundo para encontrar as causas raízes rapidamente para impulsionar as melhorias.
  • Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos sem sacrificar a qualidade ou a funcionalidade principal.
  • Fornecer suporte diário durante o lançamento / implementação de sistemas / processos mais novos e coletar feedback.
  • Utilizar continuamente ferramentas de software e hardware para garantir as operações normais do dia a dia. Garantir que os associados tenham ferramentas adequadas para realizar o trabalho e coordenar o reparo ou substituição quando necessário.
  • Comunicar as métricas diárias e relatar exceções a outros departamentos em Operações e em toda a Amazon, conforme necessário.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience with Excel
  • Experience in customer-facing environment, warehousing, logistics or manufacturing

Preferred Qualifications

  • Speak, write, and read fluently in English

Inclusive Culture

Nossa cultura inclusiva capacita os Amazonians a oferecer os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. Se você quiser solicitar uma acomodação para a entrevista ou o processo de integração, avise seu recrutador e ele o conectará à nossa equipe de acomodação.

title: Analista de Performance Pleno
description:
Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico da gestão do Centro de Serviços Compartilhados (CSC), sendo responsável por analisar indicadores operacionais, acompanhar a performance do atendimento e gerar insights que apoiem a tomada de decisão e a melhoria contínua dos processos e gerar insights que apoiem a tomada de decisão e a melhoria contínua dos processos.
  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores de desempenho do CSC (SLA, tempo de atendimento, produtividade, backlog, entre outros);
  • Criar e atualizar dashboards e relatórios gerenciais de performance; Identificar tendências, gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria nos processos operacionais;
  • Apoiar a gestão com análises, insights e recomendações acionáveis;
  • Acompanhar a gestão de chamados, garantindo o correto direcionamento e cumprimento dos prazos;
  • Apoiar a gestão de capacidade, presença e disponibilidade das equipes;
  • Elaborar apresentações gerenciais e materiais de apoio à liderança; Utilizar ferramentas de BI, automação e IA para aprofundar as análises.
  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Gestão de Processos, Tecnologia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência com análise de dados, indicadores de performance e relatórios gerenciais;
  • Excel intermediário a avançado; Experiência com Power BI;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de gestão de chamados, como ServiceNow (desejável);
  • Experiência em ambiente de CSC ou operações de atendimento (diferencial);
  • PowerPoint: Elaboração de apresentações executivas .
  • Experiência no uso de ferramentas de IA e analytics para apoio à análise de dados (ex.: uso de modelos para identificação de padrões, previsões e análises exploratórias – diferencial).

O Que Temos Para Você

description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us

SBM Offshore is a global leader in deepwater ocean infrastructure, delivering floating production solutions across the full asset lifecycle—from design and construction to installation and operation. Supported by a global team of more than 8,000 professionals, the Company operates a long-term, asset-backed business model that delivers high-availability assets and predictable cash flows. SBM Offshore combines engineering expertise, operational reliability, and selective innovation to support safe, efficient, and lower-carbon energy production, while extending its capabilities into new opportunities across the blue economy.

Reports To

Background

  • The Laboratory Technician is responsible for ensuring the product specification is correct in terms of BS &W by sampling and analysis. They have a specific responsibility for ensuring chemical stocks and rates are maintained at appropriate levels and that sample reports are communicated effectively.

Authority

  • The Laboratory Technician has authority over subordinates.

Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards

  • Carry Out Routine Sampling And Testing /Analysis Operation
  • Prepare for sampling and obtain representative samples.
  • Maintain integrity of samples before analyzing.
  • Prepare for simple testing / analysis Prepare sample for test / analysis. Conduct test / analysis.
  • Record test / analysis results within appropriate documentation.
  • Maintain safe and healthy conditions in the working environment.
  • Comply with the necessary conditions for an effective and safe working environment.
  • Follow incident and emergency procedures as required.
  • Maintain an effective and safe working environment.
  • Limit the damage to persons or property in the event of an incident or emergency.
  • Ensure That Laboratory And Field Test-Equipment Is Calibrated And Maintained
  • Identify calibration requirements for Laboratory and field test equipment.
  • Monitor adherence to calibration requirements.
  • Calibrate equipment / arrange for calibration of equipment as required.
  • Report and record calibration details within appropriate documentation.
  • Control Stocks Of Equipment, Materials And Chemicals Required For Laboratory And Plant
  • Order stocks to maintain minimum levels.
  • Receive and store stock, (including bunkering of chemicals) as required.
  • Optimize stock usage to always maintain levels.
  • Issue stock / ensure that adequate levels are available for other users.
  • Communicate Information (Written And Orally), Accurately, Concisely And Promptly
  • Process incoming and outgoing communications.
  • Receive and relay oral and written messages, data, logs etc.
  • Supply information for specific purposes / tasks.
  • Communicate with Supervisors, peers and external parties accurately, concisely and promptly.
  • Monitor and Maintain Pollution Control Measures.
  • Unplanned discharges to the environment are identified, halted where possible, and reported according to policy, procedure and regulation.
  • Relevant PPE is used to deal with unplanned discharges using company procedures.
  • Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are dealt with according to the correct procedure.
  • Environmental protection and pollution control are enforced effectively with colleagues, subordinates and subcontractors.
  • Emergency Response
  • Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).
  • Demonstrate competence in Emergency Response drills and exercises.

Recruitment Only-Generic Functional Competencies

  • Offshore - Handover
  • Offshore - Sampling
  • Offshore - Safety Management
  • Offshore - Laboratory
  • Offshore - Communications
  • Offshore - Field Operations
  • Offshore - Stock monitoring - Chemicals
  • Offshore - Analysers

Pre-hire Qualifications and Experience

  • Qualification in Chemistry required.
  • Experience as a Lab Technician in the hydrocarbon processing industry (FPSO experience preferred).
  • Practical experience of Permit to Work, Mechanical Standards and Risk Assessment.
  • Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com apromoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

  • Informar sobre fraudes, situação da ligação de água e esgoto; Informar através de ocorrência ou comunicar diretamente ao setor em caso de divergência da economia cadastrada;

  • Oferecer serviços de abastecimento de água e coleta e tratamento de esgoto;
  • Prestar informações sobre serviços de abastecimento de água e coleta e tratamento de esgoto;
  • O corte e religação de água são realizados conforme as necessidades das unidades;

  • Entregar faturas e informativos; Realizar o repasse de leitura;
  • Realizar substituição de Hidrômetros;
  • Realizar padronização de cavaletes nas ligações de água;
  • Realizar entrega de A.R. referentes às notificações por irregularidade;
  • Realizar coleta de leitura e releitura dos hidrômetros, fiscalizar ligações e realizar corte e religação de água, com objetivo de apurar o consumo mensal de cada unidade consumidora e manter o relacionamento com o cliente;
  • Manter os equipamentos de trabalho em perfeito estado de conservação e limpeza;
  • Cumprir normas e procedimentos da empresa, referentes a área de atuação;
  • Conduzir veículo que serão utilizados para atividade de maneira eficiente e segura.
  • Habilitação B

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 22.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Digital Project Manager
description:
Overview


The QIMA story At Qima, we are on a mission to offer our clients smart solutions to make products you can trust. Operating in over 100 countries, we serve the consumer products, food, and life sciences industries and help more than 30,000 brands, retailers, manufacturers, and growers achieve quality excellence. We combine on-the-ground expertise with digital solutions that bring accuracy, transparency and intelligence for quality and compliance data. We are a leading provider of supply chain compliance solutions, partnering with brands, retailers, and importers to secure, manage, and optimize their global supply network. Qima’s industry-leading experts for onsite inspections, supplier audits, and lab testing are supported by a digital platform that provides accuracy, transparency, and intelligence for quality and compliance data. Our culture is unique, with our 5,000 Qimates making decisions every day based on our Qima Values.



Job Description


Help us drive the adoption and delivery of innovative digital solutions that improve efficiency, client experience, and compliance across the global food TIC (Testing, Inspection & Certification) industry. We are looking for a Digital Project Manager who can coordinate cross-regional initiatives, support client onboarding, and ensure successful implementation of digital tools across operations. This role sits at the intersection of product, operations, and client engagement, helping translate business needs into effective digital solutions while ensuring strong adoption across regions.



Key Missions



  • Digital Project Delivery : Lead the execution of digital initiatives from planning to rollout. Coordinate with product, engineering, QA, and business teams to ensure projects are delivered on time and aligned with operational needs.

  • Client Onboarding & Adoption : Support the onboarding of internal teams and external clients to new digital tools and platforms. Monitor adoption, identify barriers to usage, and work with stakeholders to improve engagement and value realization.

  • Cross-Regional Coordination : Act as the key point of coordination between regional teams in Latin America and global teams in Asia and Europe. Ensure alignment on priorities, timelines, and implementation strategies.

  • Business Analysis & Solution Design : Work with stakeholders to understand operational needs and document requirements, workflows, and user stories. Contribute to designing practical digital solutions that improve efficiency and data quality.

  • Data & Adoption Insights : Track product usage and operational data to assess adoption and identify improvement opportunities. Use insights from client interactions and operational teams to inform future enhancements.

  • Testing & Implementation : Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and support smooth rollouts of new features and tools. Ensure issues are addressed quickly and users are supported during implementation.

  • Field Engagement : Engage directly with operational teams and auditors to observe workflows, gather feedback, and ensure digital tools effectively support real-world inspection and audit processes.



Qualifications



  • Has experience managing digital or technology projects in complex operational environments

  • Is comfortable working across regions and time zones

  • Can engage with clients and operational teams to drive adoption

  • Has strong organizational and communication skills

  • Is able to work independently while coordinating multiple stakeholders

  • Has experience with Agile or digital product delivery environments

  • Experience in Food, Quality, Compliance, or TIC industries is a plus.

title: IoT Solutions Architecture Manager (Americas only)
description:
IoT Solutions Architecture Manager (Americas only)

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring an IoT Solutions Architecture Manager to lead a regionally-focused team of Field engineers in Presales and Professional Services activities, by helping customers with solution architecture, design and delivery.

Location: This is a remote role, running a team in one of three Geos, Americas, EMEA or APAC. You will therefore need to be located in one of those three Geos to manage that specific team that spans few timezones from you

Our Internet of Things mission is to enable companies to make fleets of very secure connected devices. Canonical provides the base Ubuntu OS and kernel, with secure update and management mechanisms. Our customers create mission-critical control systems, gateways and appliances that need to meet stringent quality and security requirements, and we aspire to bring this level of security to the wider consumer electronics and device market.

Our Field Engineers are thought leaders helping our customers solve hard problems. They are accomplished technologists that take a hands-on approach to embedded Linux strategy and delivery. They have a passion to help customers achieve ambitious technical and business goals, and to show how the Canonical approach to open source and connected devices brings best-of-breed thinking to the emerging field of edge compute. They also care to develop their colleagues, helping them deepen their understanding of the technology, their ability to manage time, and their awareness of customer business thinking for continuous improvement and personal development.

This career opportunity requires a unique blend of skills. Successful candidates will know Linux well and be proficient coders and scripters. They will have experience of low-level Linux boot, BIOS, firmware and embedded software development methodologies. They also enjoy the pace of change and diversity of client engagements with driven and ambitious technology entrepreneurs. Competitive, business-focused technologists at heart, they are also team drivers that take pride in team and company wins.

The role entails

  • Lead and develop a team of Field engineers, ranging from graduate to senior, in the areas of Presales and Professional Services
  • Solve customer problems by promoting our technologies and being a trusted advisor
  • Work remotely in a single major time zone
  • Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Represent your team and product to stakeholders, partners, and customers
  • Develop and evangelise great engineering and organisational practices
  • Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science or related technical field
  • Extensive embedded Linux experience - Yocto or other
  • Fluency in at least one of Golang, Python, C, C++, or Rust
  • Ability to manage a small team
  • Experience with customer engagements
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • An ability to communicate the business benefits of technology
  • An humble learner and quick study

Other desirable traits include RTOS experience, additional languages (both the programming and human kinds), and previous experience working in a remote-first, diverse, distributed company.

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

Capacidade de seguir normas e instruções: atenção ao cumprimento de regras, incluindo normas de segurança, uso correto de EPIs e procedimentos operacionais.

Flexibilidade: adaptabilidade para lidar com diferentes demandas, como pequenas manutenções ou apoio a outras áreas da empresa.

Somos movidos pelo propósito de criar um Brasil ativo e sem dor, transformando relações na saúde, oferecendo um ecossistema de excelência a pacientes com doenças musculoesquelético e de terapia assistida.

Estamos em transformação e buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte da nossa história, mas para trabalhar conosco você precisa se reconhecer nos nossos valores:

FOCO NAS PESSOAS

Nossos valores

Pessoas são o nosso DNA: Somos justos nas relações com os pacientes, colegas de trabalho, parceiros e prestadores de serviço. Incentivamos sonhos e valorizamos as pessoas por suas competências. Simplificamos para fazer bem feito: Antecipamos os problemas e buscamos realizar as atividades da forma mais eficiente, agindo de imediato e de forma coordenada com foco na solução. Queremos mais: Buscamos incansavelmente a evolução, valorizando feedbacks e nos preocupando em sempre entregar a melhor experiência. Empoderamos as pessoas: Somos proativos para solucionar problemas e buscar oportunidades, assumimos responsabilidade pelas atividades exercidas, sem transferi-la para outros.

Se você quer fazer a diferença, achou o lugar certo! Venha fazer história com a gente!

description:
Senior Media Relations Manager

Department: Communications

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Head of Media Relations, FIFA Women's World Cup 27™, the Senior Media Relations Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Corporate Communications and Media Relations team, and work in close collaboration with the Zurich-based FIFA Communications and Media Relations teams and other key individuals responsible for delivering Public Relations efforts for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027.

This role will be responsible for executing comprehensive media engagement strategies to promote the tournament, manage media relations, and ensure effective messaging is delivered to and through journalists. Further, this role will support the Head of Corporate Communications and Media Relations in proactive story ideation, pitching and placement across targeted media throughout the tournament footprint and beyond to maintain a positive public image and enhance engagement during the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The main responsibilities and oversights of the Senior Media Relations Manager for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™ include:

  • Contribute to the development and execution of integrated media engagement strategies that effectively promote the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027, aligning with event objectives and messaging.
  • Coordinate the distribution of compelling and accurate press releases, news articles, and media materials.
  • Monitor media coverage and social media sentiment, providing timely insights and suggesting the adjustment of communication strategies as needed.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure consistent messaging across media channels and touchpoints.
  • Coordinate media events, press conferences, and media-related logistics in advance of, and during the tournament, ensuring smooth execution, in coordination with the Media Operations team.
  • Foster positive relationships with media outlets, journalists, and influencers to enhance event coverage and visibility.
  • Evaluate communication efforts post-event, analysing successes and areas for improvement to inform future strategies and initiatives.
  • Support the FIFA and FIFA Women's World Cup Communications team in implementing the spokespeople policy developed for the tournament, including the evaluation and approval of interview requests for members of the management team.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 8 years experience in communications, media and public relations
  • Familiarity with the world of football and a passion for women’s football
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written) and Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Spanish language skills are an asset
  • Able and willing to relocate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Able and willing to travel up to 50% of the year
  • Able and willing to work non-traditional hours including evenings and weekends as needed

description:
Multi Site Environmental Manager, Environmental Assurance and Protection (EAP)

Brazil's Environmental Assurance and Protection (EAP) team is seeking a Multi Site Environmental Manager (MSEM) to support our Amazon Operations. This role supports multiple sites. The MSEM will develop standards and policies to support regulatory compliance as well as partner with operations leadership teams for execution of these standards and policies, to ensure compliance with all applicable county/locations specific Federal, State and local laws and regulations. The MSEM travels greater than 50% of the time.

Key job responsibilities

  • Manage and execute multi site responsibilities to comply with stormwater, waste, wastewater and other environmental related laws, regulations and permits. This includes required Federal, State and local reporting.
  • Manage and execute business conformance with Amazon EAP Management Systems Policies. Develop Amazon Geo-Specific Operational Environmental Procedures by integrating with engineering, construction and operations.
  • Lead regulatory agency interactions, permit evaluation and processing, and new process and technology introduction.
  • Primary point of contact for environmental regulatory agencies and represents Amazon at appropriate levels with governmental agencies and throughout the company.
  • Ensure work performed by contractors, consultants, and employees is completed in accordance with regulatory requirements and Amazon standards.
  • Monitor environmental metrics to review trends to determine where improvements are needed.
  • Conduct thorough and accurate environmental inspections and audits for continuous improvement.
  • Prioritize and manage multiple, technically complex assignments, concurrently.
  • Build and manage collaborative relationships with various stakeholders to ensure risks are identified early and managed appropriately.
  • Compile and submit time critical reports to various governmental agencies.
  • Complete thorough and accurate environmental incident investigations and associated regulatory reports, and develop appropriate corrective actions.
  • Ensure site leadership and associates are trained and knowledgeable of their responsibilities under each policy.

A day in the life

The MSEM will complete environmental performance analysis, establish and monitor metrics, and guide the operations leadership teams in implementation of Amazon environmental standards. The MSEM will work with internal and external partners that include government entities, contractors, consultants, design, construction, operations and other key stakeholders.

About the team

The EAP organization protects Amazon businesses and supports the needs of our customers by proactively mitigating environmental regulatory risks and protecting the environment.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in the Environmental Sciences, Environmental Engineering, or related field
  • Experience developing and implementing environmental compliance programs including regulated waste, water, and air regulations in accordance with applicable laws
  • Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience engaging with regulatory agencies in permit applications or equivalent
  • Experience in environmental compliance and permitting, waste management, contractual, regulatory, and liability assessments, environmental permit evaluations and applications, EIAs and water discharge requirements
  • Knowledge of Brazilian state and federal environmental regulations

title: Venue Technology
description:
Venue Technology Manager

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Venue Technology Manager is responsible for supporting the Technology team with venue specific technology related deliverables for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 TM (FWWC 2027) within Brazil. The role entails coordinating with all relevant parties the planning, implementation, readiness and operations of all Event Technology services pertinent to the tournament and / or associated events within Brazil.

Key Responsibilities

  • Responsible to ensure all aspects of Technology, Telecommunications and Broadcast Technology Services are implemented in accordance with the pre-agreed FIFA Technology requirements at the assigned venue(s)
  • Manage a strong diverse Venue Technology team composed of paid staff, contractors and volunteers for operating the technology services at the assigned venue(s)
  • Collaborate with stakeholders’ groups, clients, providers, and government entities in relation to ensuring the delivery of technology services across all venues, in accordance with the defined governance structure
  • Manage and contribute to the venue technology working groups in accordance with the agreed governance structure across all aspects of the tournament programme (planning, implementation, readiness and operations)
  • Manage the technology demand / needs requirements for technology services across the tournament space (Technology Equipment Allocation Process)
  • Plan the delivery of suitable end user technology equipment and services to all FWWC 2027 departments and FIFA constituent groups, including hardware, services and consumables
  • Facilitate the collection and distribution of technology requirements of all client groups involved in the FWWC 2027 across all client groups, including, Media, Broadcast, Commercial, Football Technology etc.
  • Ensure that all information pertaining to infrastructure, services and spaces needed for the delivery and support of all technology services are communicated to, and understood by, venue/site authorities and respective delivery teams
  • Provide guidance and direction to relevant teams on matters relating to the structural build-out and technology services implementation, including the commissioning and final decommissioning of tournament venues
  • In collaboration with assigned personnel and Stadium partners, relevant parties (private and governmental) enable / support the timely delivery of venue technology services.
  • Identify and report on the progress of all critical dependencies in accordance with the reporting methodologies
  • Manage the asset tracking and management of deployed technology equipment
  • Track the progress of structural build-out and IT implementation leading up to the timely availability of components and services and including the commissioning and final decommissioning of the venues
  • Develop regular progress, risk and issue management reports in accordance with the governance structure / reporting methodologies and, or PMO systems
  • Follow‑up with various stakeholders, providers, and government entities in relation to ensuring delivery of technology services / dependencies as per agreed requirements, service levels etc.
  • Support and ensure the team adhere to the IT Service management protocols
  • Ensure positive attitude from the Venue Technology teams and good relationship with all the parties, including FIFA teams, Local FIFA Subsidiary (LFS) areas/projects, end‑users, suppliers, Host Country/ City counterparts
  • Manage the on‑site IT Technicians and support teams during tournament time operations, including end‑of‑day reporting and incident escalation to Technology Command Centre.

Your Profile

Education

  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field

Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years overall IT experience and minimum 4 years of experience in a similar role
  • Experience in the Sports / major event industry is a must
  • Proven track record of successful delivery of complex IT programs and projects

Skills & Competencies

  • Manager with proven track record in similar projects
  • Good knowledge of venue technology services across major sporting events
  • Have up to date knowledge and project management expertise in all event related technologies, including, all types of technology business solutions, community access TV (CATV), radio communications, wired communication, printing, broadcast contribution network, spectrum, audio and visual.
  • Ability to always maintain a professional

  • Zelar pela correta utilização do uniforme e EPIs, asseio pessoal, materiais e produtos, conforme padronização de acordo com procedimento, orientação do superior hierárquico e normas de segurança;

  • Conferir o abastecimento do material e distribuição quando necessário, checar o DML (depósito de material de limpeza) e carrinho funcional, para que o colaborador execute suas funções diárias;

  • Atentar para a aplicação prática dos conhecimentos adquiridos nos treinamentos realizados no contrato, para multiplicação das práticas adequadas;

  • Monitorar assiduidade e pontualidade dos colaboradores através do acompanhamento da Folha e Cartão de ponto;
  • Higienizar o material e utensílios utilizados no plantão anterior, organizando e acondicionando em local específico para continuidade das atividades previstas;
  • Ler e registrar informações no livro de ocorrência, no início e ao final do plantão, visando adequada continuidade das atividades do contrato;
  • Fazer a passagem de plantão em conjunto com a liderança do outro plantão, fazendo a ronda nos setores, sinalizando as ocorrências, registrando as informações, visando adequada continuidade das atividades no contrato;

  • Realizar a diluição de produtos químicos de limpeza corretamente, seguindo as recomendações de segurança do trabalho, bem como também as orientações fornecidas pelo fabricante do(s) produto(s), FISPQs e treinamentos aplicados;

description:
At The Coca-Cola Company, our purpose is to refresh the world and make a difference. We’re accelerating our momentum by putting people at the center of everything we do—bringing cutting‑edge excellence in marketing, innovation, and activation to life in the market.

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Customer Activation to spearhead the strategy, execution, and optimization of integrated marketing and brand activation programs across customers and channels. This role will be accountable for leading high‑impact initiatives that align with global brand strategies, translating Integrated Marketing Experience (IMX) plans into groundbreaking customer‑facing activations. As a leader in this space, you will balance strategic oversight with tactical execution while fostering collaboration across teams to deliver measurable business growth, through customer innovation and market differentiation.

The ideal candidate is a dynamic leader, a creative thinker, and results‑driven with a proven ability to guide multifunctional teams to deliver cutting‑edge customer marketing programs. This position calls for an individual who is enthusiastic about elevating iconic brands in a complex and evolving marketplace.

What You’ll Do for Us

Strategic Ownership & Market Activation Leadership

  • Own and lead the overall development, implementation, and evaluation of innovative customer and channel activation programs that align with business priorities.

  • Drive the customization of global and regional marketing strategies into actionable customer and locally relevant activation plans.

  • Ensure deliverables exceed business objectives in volume, revenue, visibility, and brand equity, while adapting to the evolving requirements of customers and channels.

  • Anticipate market trends and align customer activation campaigns to optimize market agility and consumer relevance.

Integrated Marketing Leadership (IMX)

  • Steer seamless execution across all IMX touchpoints, including POS, packaging, promotions, experiential, digital, social, and local media, ensuring strategic integration and alignment with our broader marketing objectives.

  • Provide oversight and leadership over cross‑functional teams, including Marketing, Shopper Marketing, IMX, Digital, Media, and Sales teams, uniting efforts to execute a consistent consumer and customer journey.

  • Actively champion the execution of fully integrated campaigns within company guidelines and communication frameworks, while innovating across traditional and non‑traditional platforms.

Asset Optimization & Partnership Development

  • Lead large‑scale activation projects leveraging global assets, sponsorships, and strategic partnerships, ensuring high‑impact executions across multiple platforms (retail, on‑premise, experiential, PR, and digital).

  • Maximize ROI by identifying opportunities to efficiently leverage internal and external assets while ensuring alignment with global branding strategies and standards.

  • Maintain a strong governance framework around asset policies, company guidelines, and legal and contractual requirements.

Agency and Vendor Leadership

  • Build robust partnerships with agency and supplier networks (creative, merchandising, promotions, etc.) to deliver best‑in‑class marketing support.

  • Develop comprehensive and actionable activation briefs, guiding agencies to produce innovative and high‑impact solutions in alignment with objectives and metrics.

  • Drive vendor accountability through consistent management, ongoing feedback, and clear quality expectations.

Executional Excellence & Accountability

  • Champion excellence in execution, delivering activation plans on time, on budget, and with the highest quality across all touchpoints.

  • Continuously evaluate activation performance against KPIs to identify areas for optimization and ensure maximum effectiveness.

  • Implement a feedback loop to leverage data for decision‑making and integrate learnings into future activation plans, constantly improving efficiency and impact.

Leadership in Governance & Brand Advocacy

  • Act as a trusted steward and champion for Coca‑Cola brands by ensuring all activation materials (POS, packaging, promotions, etc.) comply with legal guidelines, internal policies, and brand protection standards.

  • Support frontline teams by ensuring all assets safeguard brand trademarks and equity, while enabling effective local customization.

People & Team Leadership Responsibilities

  • Provide strategic leadership to the team by connecting individual roles and responsibilities to broader organizational objectives, ensuring focus on delivering meaningful business growth.

  • Coach and mentor direct and cross‑functional team members, building marketing acumen and project management capabilities for long‑term success.

  • Foster an inclusive, collaborative, and high‑performance culture, ensuring respect for diverse perspectives and driving a shared sense of accountability within the team.

  • Collaborate closely with senior leadership and cross‑functional teams to influence strategic decision‑making and implement impactful initiatives.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field (MBA preferred).

  • 8–12 years of experience in marketing activation, customer marketing, integrated marketing, or shopper marketing, including demonstrated leadership managing cross‑functional teams and agencies in a matrixed organization.

  • Proven expertise transforming global and brand marketing strategies into action‑oriented customer activations with measurable results.

  • Strong knowledge of integrated marketing principles, consumer and shopper marketing strategies, and the dynamics of channel/customer relationships.

  • Expertise in delivering excellence across IMX touchpoints, with sound project management skills and agile responsiveness in fast‑moving environments.

  • A history of successfully leading external partners (agencies, suppliers) with a focus on executional quality, disciplined budget management, and creative problem‑solving.

  • Exceptional ability to influence and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders while demonstrating strong executive presence.

  • Fluent in English, with additional language skills highly regarded.

What We’ll Do for You

  • Strategic Impact: Lead the way in reimagining customer and channel‑oriented brand activation strategies that elevate Coca‑Cola's powerful portfolio of global brands.

  • Leadership Growth: Develop your leadership skills through cross‑functional engagements and high‑impact responsibilities across multiple touchpoints and channels.

  • Career Expansion: Opportunities to excel in IMX leadership and marketing strategy roles, and a clear pathway to Director‑level growth within The Coca‑Cola Company.

  • Professional Development: Access marketing resources, industry‑leading tools, and on‑demand development experiences tailored to accelerate your career trajectory.

title: Advanced Fuels Project Lead
description:
Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Job Family Group

Research and Development

Worker Type

Regular

Posting Start Date

March 16, 2026

Business Unit

Projects and Technology

Experience Level

Experienced Professionals

What’s the role

The Advanced Fuels Project Lead will be responsible for conducting end‑to‑end techno‑economic assessments across a portfolio of low‑carbon fuel pathways, from early conceptual definition and process modelling through to economic evaluation and decision‑support for business stakeholders. The role requires close collaboration with researchers, process engineers, technology developers, and commercial teams to ensure technical quality, coherence of assumptions, and transparent translation of results into Shell's strategic options. The selected candidate will engage with internal Shell Experts to validate methodologies and typically oversee and contribute to 6‑10 technology projects.

Technology Theme Development and Assessment

  • Oversight and management of budget expenditure for projects delivered under his/her responsibility, guaranteeing the Levy compliance.
  • Work with internal and external stakeholders to identify key technology themes of strategic importance to the Low‑Carbon Fuels (LCF) business and which can be developed through externally funded R&D projects.
  • Plan, facilitate and participate in technology workshops and other stakeholder events to develop an in‑depth understanding of the technology challenges and opportunities facing LCF and potential routes to solutions.
  • Lead Techno‑Economic Assessments (TEA) for emerging and advanced fuel pathways, including SAF, green/renewable diesel, hydrogen, e‑fuels, and biomass‑derived intermediates.
  • Develop and optimise detailed process models in Aspen Tech (or similar simulators), ensuring robust mass & energy balances and rigorous thermodynamic property selection.
  • Translate process simulation outputs into scalable cost models, including CAPEX, OPEX, sensitivity analyses, and uncertainty quantification.
  • Assess feedstock‑to‑fuel pathways, identifying technical bottlenecks, scale‑up barriers, integration opportunities, and overall commercial viability.
  • Benchmark novel technologies against conventional processes to support go/no‑go decisions, portfolio prioritisation, and strategic roadmaps.

Proposal Management

  • Align the projects under her/his responsibility with third parties with Shell Strategy.
  • Develop and make recommendations with respect to optimisation of its portfolio through value analysis, maximising R&D levy qualification and value delivered, building relationships with strategic partners, creating value for Shell and guaranteeing the real translation of the benefits to the company.
  • In conjunction with internal and external stakeholders review and rank project proposals in line with the Low‑Carbon Energy Programme strategic requirements, with particular focus on the assessment of business value to Shell and project risk management and mitigation.
  • Liaise with potential partners to ensure a common understanding of the technologies to be developed and provide technical support to the development of cooperation agreements to the strategic benefit of Shell.
  • Undertake the necessary due diligence and develop the necessary materials to take projects through the appropriate internal sanction process and provide the required technical and project management input to the finalisation of contracts with supplier(s).

Project Management

  • Provide project management expertise to ensure effective and timely delivery of Technology projects.
  • Set, agree and monitor performance standards for projects ensuring compliance especially HSSE and Ethics & Compliance standards/policies relevant to the R&D activities undertaken by suppliers and Universities.
  • Work closely with the developers and other funders to ensure that the sponsors' requirements are being met and if required, provide project management support to the developer team: meet with the developers on a regular basis to ensure that targets are being achieved and give project direction.
  • Ensure that projects are professionally managed and are driven to deliver the agreed outputs within budget, interfacing with Shell technical experts and assets as required.
  • Progress projects in the Technology maturation tollgates.

Relationship Management

  • Identify appropriate stakeholders and engage/manage relationship(s) at appropriate level. This extends to other oil and gas companies, Universities, State and Federal Research Councils, Regulatory authorities e.g. ANP, CNPq etc.
  • Manage project relationships to ensure appropriate oversight of the projects, identify and maintain engagement in the programmes from the participants and promote integration between work streams towards a common goal.

General

  • Maintain surveillance of the wider technology arena, and track developments, competitor and supplier activity with potential relevance to the Low‑Carbon Tech agenda: attend relevant industry conferences, develop networks of contacts etc.
  • Communicate effectively at all levels, both internally and externally: share knowledge with relevant internal and external stakeholders.

What you bring

  • Must have legal authorization to work in Brazil on a full‑time basis for anyone other than the current employer.
  • Bachelor's degree in chemical or mechanical engineering is required (PhD degree is desirable).
  • 5+ years of experience in related field.
  • Technical and analytical expertise in research and development.
  • Strong expertise in Aspen Tech (steady‑state modelling, reactors, separation trains, property methods).
  • Proven experience conducting TEA for energy, fuels, or chemical processes, including cost estimation methodologies (estimates, equipment sizing, scaling laws).
  • Deep knowledge of process engineering principles, reaction systems, heat/mass transfer, and process integration.
  • Familiarity with advanced fuel technologies such as HEFA, FT‑SAF, ATJ, gasification routes, e‑methanol, green hydrogen, ammonia, or similar.
  • Ability to connect technical insights to economic, sustainability, and commercial outcomes.
  • Solid knowledge in Project Management.
  • The ability to work productively with a range of personnel and disciplines, both within Technical and the assets and both technical and non‑technical.
  • Fluent in both written and spoken Portuguese and English is essential.
  • Good interpersonal and relationship building skills, with the ability to interact effectively with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders at all levels.
  • Must be a good written and verbal communicator, able to present and summarise issues concisely.
  • Must be a clear thinker, able to assimilate and analyse a wide range of information and generate pragmatic solutions.
  • Ability to influence key internal and external stakeholders.
  • This role requires frequent travel, estimated at approximately 25%.

What we offer

  • Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
  • Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
  • Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
  • Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
  • Achieve your balance in a values‑led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
  • Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.
  • Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance related salary increase - our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.
  • Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non‑birthing parents.
  • Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
  • Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams.
  • Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

Shell is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

  • Gestão de Backlog e Roadmap com Priorização de Funcionalidades: Manter e priorizar o backlog do produto, definindo funcionalidades com base em valor de negócio, viabilidade técnica e necessidades dos usuários.

title: Sr Front-end Engineer - HTS Stays & Packages (100% Remote - Brazil)
description:
About the job

Did you know Hopper technology powers some of the largest travel portals in the world? Our Hopper Technology Solutions (HTS) platform drives travel purchases for major global brands — from banks to airlines to fintech leaders. This platform is essentially a configurable, multi-tenant travel commerce engine, enabling partners to launch world‑class hotel and travel booking experiences faster, with less custom engineering.

Our Stays & Packages team focuses specifically on accommodation and bundled travel experiences: hotels, alternative stays, and packages combining flights, cars, and lodging. We build the booking flows, search experiences, checkout journeys, and platform capabilities that power these products across multiple partner portals worldwide.

We’re looking for a Senior Frontend / Full-Stack Engineer who wants to work at the intersection of travel product, platform engineering, and user experience.

This role isn’t just about shipping UI features; it’s about shaping how lodging and package booking experiences scale across partners while maintaining performance, usability, and long‑term maintainability.

What would your day-to-day look like

  • Work with a group of top‑tier engineers in a low‑process environment powered by trust and autonomy
  • Drive decisions and consensus asynchronously with thoughtful documentation
  • Ship fast. Learn fast. Repeat. Build new features from top to bottom, from UX to database
  • Architect scalable front‑end solutions that allow us to efficiently launch new portals.
  • Work directly with PMs and business partners to help define and refine our roadmap. Your voice matters.
  • Collaborate cross‑functionally with a diverse group of people, giving and receiving feedback for growth

An ideal candidate has:

  • Deep expertise in React with modern compiler‑driven patterns (functional components, hooks, performance optimizations, server‑side rendering, hydration, and advanced state management).
  • Proficiency in TypeScript, with experience developing and maintaining enterprise‑scale applications.
  • Advanced CSS knowledge (Tailwind, SCSS, CSS‑in‑JS, animations, and handling browser quirks).
  • Familiarity with contemporary frontend tooling (e.g., React Query/TanStack ecosystem, Tailwind or design‑token‑based styling, modern build tools like Vite). Experience working in monorepos (e.g., Turbo, Nx, pnpm workspaces) is a plus too.
  • Solid frontend architecture fundamentals: performance, accessibility, responsive design, testing, and maintainability
  • Experience optimizing frontend performance (lazy loading, code‑splitting, caching strategies, Lighthouse optimizations, etc.).
  • Experience working on complex product flows such as e‑commerce, travel, marketplace, or fintech applications.
  • Ability to balance shipping product features with long‑term platform thinking in multi‑brand or white‑label environments.
  • Familiarity with SSR and static site generation (e.g., Next.js) for SEO‑friendly experiences.
  • A passion for writing testable code knowing what to test, what not to test, and what kinds of tests matter in front‑end applications.

Bonus:

Full‑stack engineers with a frontend tilt are very welcome, especially those comfortable collaborating across API design, backend systems and cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, etc.). This is a nice to have , but not mandatory .

Perks and benefits of working with us:

  • Well‑funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre‑IPO equity packages.
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend.
  • Hopper will cover 100% of the employee premiums for EOR‑offered health, dental, life and short term disability insurances with SulAmerica.
  • Hopper offers employees in Brazil monthly meal vouchers.
  • Very generous parental leave.
  • Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work‑from‑home stipend.
  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
  • Open communication with management and company leadership.
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.

More about Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world‑class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end‑to‑end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:

Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.

Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no‑questions‑asked resolutions.

Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.

Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.

Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co‑develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen‑Z and millennials travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.

title: Especialista de Operações - Automação
description:
Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

Por que trabalhar conosco?

Porque somos a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão em prática fazendo a diferença nos 178 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 26 milhões de pessoas. Somos inspirados a transformar o futuro e melhorar a forma que as pessoas vivem. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos a nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de dezenas de cidades, levando saúde, dignidade e bem-estar.

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizará o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

A partir de 2020 passou por uma revisão e seu objetivo foi reconfigurado: espelhar a população negra em todos os níveis hierárquicos.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

  • Apoiar nos projetos de abastecimento de água e transporte de esgoto;
  • Identificar gargalos e propor soluções de melhorias de maneira rápida e eficiente;
  • Manter interface do COI com a unidade de negócio e com os outros setores (apoio com modelagem, TI, perdas, comunicação, despacho e serviços);
  • Apoiar a unidade de negócio nos eventos, seja na busca pela causa raiz ou na organização do evento;
  • Garantir que o time interno entenda e conheça o abastecimento de cada unidade de negócio.
  • Ensino superior completo Engenharia ou áreas afins;
  • Pacote Office avançado, com ênfase em Excel;
  • Desejável conhecimento de Power BI e Qgis;
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos de Hidráulica de redes pressurizadas.
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos de Sistemas de abastecimento de água.
  • Habilidade de Leitura e interpretação de curvas de perda de carga.
  • Instrumentação de campo (medidores de vazão, pressão, dataloggers).
  • Conhecimeto de Softwares de modelagem hidráulica (EPANET, InfoWater, WaterGEMS).
  • Noções de GIS.
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • AE Orienta - Aconselhamento Psicológico, Financeiro, Jurídico e social;
  • Auxilio creche para as mães;
  • Empréstimo consignado em folha;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados.

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 22.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

Buscamos pessoa responsável pelo relacionamento comercial com clientes nos diversos segmentos industriais, com o objetivo de agregar valor ao cliente através de produtos e serviços, garantindo satisfação e fidelização.

Principais atividades

  • Visitar os clientes da sua carteira (fábricas e escritórios), atuando no planejamento estratégico de visitas, visando cobrir a região estabelecida.
  • Atuar em conjunto com time de engenharia de aplicação do distribuidor local para que possam fazer análises e proposições técnicas para resoluções de problemas e/ou implantações de novos projetos em clientes.
  • Atuar na especificação técnica de materiais, por meio de coleta de dados de processo junto ao cliente, a fim de fornecer uma solução que atenda às necessidades de processo do cliente com o melhor custo de aquisição e com alta durabilidade.
  • Acompanhar quando necessário em cooperação com o nosso distribuidor local, a elaboração dos orçamentos e relatórios técnicos de produtos de acordo com a necessidade dos clientes, visando assegurar diferencial competitivo ao negócio.
  • Registrar as informações relacionadas às oportunidades de negócios no sistema de CRM, assegurando que todos os dados sejam precisos e atualizados.
  • Manter os cadastros dos clientes sempre atualizados, garantindo a integridade e a qualidade das informações disponíveis para a equipe e para a tomada de decisões estratégicas.
  • Converter as visitas aos clientes em vendas, colaborando com o atingimento do plano de meta de vendas estabelecida pela companhia.
  • Acompanhar o faturamento de materiais, com o auxílio do relatório de backlog do sistema e alinhamento com a fábrica, com a finalidade de cumprir com o prazo de entrega acordado com o cliente e atingir a meta de faturamento.
  • Manter relacionamento com o cliente como parte da estratégia de vendas e gestão comercial, provendo suporte com informações de data de entrega, faturamento, instalação e start-up dos materiais, assegurando o devido funcionamento e desempenho dos mesmos.
  • Definição e participação em atividades orientadas ao mercado, como feiras, palestras e eventos corporativos.

Qualificações Necessárias

  • 3 anos de experiência com vendas técnicas.
  • Ensino superior em Engenharia Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Química ou Técnico em Mecânica.
  • Conhecimento em processos industriais, especialmente nos segmentos químico e petroquímico.
  • Diferencial possuir noções sobre sistemas de vapor e automação/instrumentação.
  • Vivência em gestão de contas.
  • Experiência com Técnicas de Negociação.
  • Capacidade analítica para identificar oportunidades de negócio a partir de dados.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.
  • Inglês intermediário.

Sobre o Grupo Spirax

O negócio de Soluções Térmicas a Vapor é um dos três negócios do Grupo Spirax. A Spirax Sarco e a Gestra são nossas duas marcas que formam a Steam Thermal Solutions e são líderes globais no fornecimento de soluções de engenharia para o projeto, fornecimento e manutenção de sistemas de vapor industriais e comerciais eficientes. A Steam Thermal Solutions tem cobertura global em 67 unidades operacionais (chamadas OpCos), organizadas em quatro divisões: EMEA, APAC, Américas e Gestra.

O Spirax Group é um grupo multinacional de engenharia industrial FTSE100 e FTSE4Good, especializado no controle e gerenciamento de vapor, soluções térmicas elétricas, bombeamento peristáltico e tecnologias de fluidos associadas.

Nosso objetivo é criar valor sustentável para todos os nossos acionistas à medida que projetamos um mundo mais eficiente, seguro e sustentável. Nossas tecnologias desempenham um papel essencial em processos industriais críticos e equipamentos industriais em setores tão diversos como Alimentos e Bebidas, Farmacêutico e Biotecnologia, Geração de Energia, Semicondutores e Saúde. Com clientes em 165 países, fornecemos as soluções que estão por trás da produção de muitos itens usados na vida cotidiana, de feijões cozidos a telefones celulares!

Nenhum restante de nosso Propósito, apoiado por nossa cultura e valores inclusivos, nos une, orienta nossas decisões e nos inspira em todos os lugares em que atuamos. Apoiamos nossos colegas para que façam a diferença uns para os outros, bem como para clientes, comunidades, fornecedores, nosso planeta e acionistas, criando um ambiente de trabalho verdadeiramente equitativo, onde todos se sintam incluídos.

Todos estão incluídos no Grupo Spirax

Somos apaixonados pela criação de culturas de trabalho inclusivas e equitativas, onde todos possam ser eles mesmos e atingir seu pleno potencial. Para nós, isso significa equipes de apoio e relacionamentos sólidos em que a contribuição de todos é valorizada - em todas as origens sociais e culturais, etnias, idades, gêneros, identidades de gênero, habilidades, neurodiversidade, orientação sexual, crenças religiosas e tudo o mais que nos torna humanos e únicos.

Sabemos que todo mundo também precisa de ajuda extra de vez em quando, por isso introduzimos uma série de benefícios adicionais por meio de nossos Compromissos de Inclusão do Grupo. Esses benefícios incluem licença parental de gênero neutro, 15 dias de licença remunerada extra para cuidadores, folga remunerada e apoio a qualquer pessoa que esteja passando por perda de gravidez ou abuso doméstico, princípios de local de trabalho favorável à menopausa e muito mais. Saiba mais em gestra a qualquer site da Spirax Group em formato textual.
